boundary: Union of successful same-code COMPLETE windows and, for NAV, independently audited current/historical market-date ingestion windows and checksum-verified native empty day observations. Historical market windows use their retained same-day ETF universe, never the larger current roster. Historical payload checksums, schema, count and all normalized values were revalidated against canonical rows; native market responses have separate checksum and exact-value evidence. No market request fabricates per-code checkpoints. Zero responses are observations; overlapping failures remain failed; coverage does not certify every disclosure or revision.
